Name: Hunger and Hydration
Author: DeyvidMods
Description:
HUNGER AND HYDRATION

Hunger and Hydration adds a lightweight hunger and hydration system to Stardew Valley while keeping the experience simple and close to the style of the original game.

The mod introduces two new needs that develop naturally throughout the day: Hunger and Hydration. Both are displayed through custom vertical HUD bars designed to fit alongside Stardew Valley's original interface.

FEATURES

• Hunger System
Your character gradually becomes hungry as time passes. Physical activities also contribute to the need for food, making meals more meaningful throughout the day.

Eating food restores hunger based on what your character consumes.

• Hydration System
Hydration gradually decreases throughout the day and is designed to require more frequent attention than hunger.

Drinks can restore hydration, giving beverages a more useful role during normal gameplay.

• Activity-Based Needs
Hunger and hydration aren't based only on the clock. Performing physical activities can increase how quickly your character's needs decrease.

This makes demanding days around the farm, mines, or other activities feel different from quieter days.

• Fresh Water
You can drink directly from suitable freshwater sources.

Stand near the water and interact with it to receive the option to drink.

Drinking fresh water restores hydration.

• Seawater
Not every source of water is safe to drink.

Drinking seawater will make your hydration worse instead of restoring it.

• Sleep Doesn't Completely Reset Your Needs
Going to bed does not magically restore hunger or hydration.

Your character continues to consume a small amount of both needs while sleeping, while the system is balanced so you don't simply wake up starving or severely dehydrated after a normal night.

• Low Need Warnings
The game will warn you when your hunger or hydration begins reaching low levels, giving you time to eat or drink before the situation becomes more serious.

• Vanilla-Style HUD
Hunger and Hydration have their own vertical bars designed to visually fit alongside Stardew Valley's existing health and energy interface.

F = Hunger
A = Hydration / Water

Hovering over either bar displays its current value out of 100.

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Hunger and Hydration is intentionally focused.

The goal isn't to turn Stardew Valley into an overly complicated survival game. Instead, the mod adds two simple needs that make food, drinks, daily activity, and access to water more meaningful.

There are no unnecessary survival systems added just for complexity. The focus is exactly what the name suggests:

Hunger and Hydration.

REQUIREMENTS

• SMAPI

INSTALLATION

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Hunger and Hydration.
3. Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

IMPORTANT

This is the first public release of Hunger and Hydration.

If you encounter unexpected behavior, compatibility problems, or errors, please report them in the Posts section and include your SMAPI log whenever possible.

Enjoy your farm — and remember to eat and drink!
